about_the_game:
Short adventure game 

Around 1 hour for 100% completion. This game was made during a game jam (game making competition) in just a few days. I enjoyed this game, so I decided to make a full playable version and share it for free!

Infiltrate a haunted cave with your team of ghosts.

A friendly ghost was reported missing when exploring a deep cave alone. This cave was, in fact, haunted! You assemble a team of ghosts to go inside and get your ally back to the surface!

Escape from cursed specters to stay alive.

Dark ghosts are filling the place and absorb the energy of anyone daring to go inside. The tunnels are dark and narrow, so you can't see far, and the specters may jump on you from anywhere!

Stay at a distance from them, or they will absorb your life! Each dark entity moves randomly and can hide inside the walls, so they may attack you from unexpected angles!

Start fires to replenish your health and keep the specters away.

Find ancient abandoned campfires hidden in the dark abyss. Light them with ghostly fire to replenish your health and keep the evil specters away.

They will also help you find your way back to the surface, when all other lights will have faded, as you venture deeper and deeper into the dark.

Discover mysterious places on your journey down the Dark Abyss.

There are weird things to discover in this forbidden place, where no one dares to go.

Hand-drawn colorful Pixel Art

Because we like beautiful things.

No Generative AI

Everything in this game (story, images, music, code...) is made by a human WITHOUT the use of any AI.

No asset flip

All images are created for this game or for other games from the same author.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: 11th Gen Intel Core i3 or equivalent processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 3D graphics card
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Not tested on hardware with less than 4GB RAM, but will likely run on most systems.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: You lead a team of ghosts to infiltrate a dark and haunted cave in this adventure game. Avoid the Dark Specters to survive, and look for a lost friend in the depths of the abyss. But the deeper you go, the more your light will fade away...
